articles.title: Tether expands tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with real estate
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with institutional real estate assets with plans to expand to other asset classes.

articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
articles.snippet: Federal prosecutors say Taj Tarsha misled backers and used investor funds for personal expenses.

articles.title: S&P 500 added all of crypto's $2 trillion market cap in a month while bitcoin barely moved. Here's why
articles.snippet: The S&P 500 just added roughly the entire crypto market's value this month. Bitcoin has barely moved, and the reasons go beyond the obvious.

articles.title: Crypto firm RedotPay says it will defend itself ‘vigorously’ against Binance lawsuit
articles.snippet: Binance alleged RedotPay poached customers from the crypto exchange in a lawsuit filed in Hong Kong.
